description: Everything besides the plan and the recipes that the handwritten list depends on. Confirmed by the household on 2026-10-12 unless a basis says otherwise.

noRecipe.description: Meals that never have a recipe. They produce no list lines.

recipePending.description: Dishes whose recipe the household will add later. Until then they produce no list lines.
meals: Spätzle (selbstgemacht), the side to the steak

freeEntries.description: Lines on the handwritten list that belong to no recipe. The household adds them by hand.

pendingLines.description: Handwritten lines that will come from a recipe that is still pending. The meal named is my reading of which one; move a line to freeEntries if it is a free entry after all.

atHome.description: Ticked in the 'Haben wir schon?' step, on top of the pantry staples that are pre-ticked. Derived: the recipes need these and the handwritten list does not have them.

boughtLater.description: Needed on Sunday and too fresh to buy on Monday. Expected in the 'buy later' section, not on the Monday list.
